About Us
-->
Welcome to Knightstown Elevator, Inc. (KEI) a family-owned business proudly serving the community for over 65 years. Established in 1961 by the Haase Family, we are deeply rooted in Knightstown, Indiana, and dedicated to delivering exceptional products and services to our customers.
As a trusted partner in agriculture, KEI buys grain and is a proud dealer of Kent & Kalmbach Feed, offering a comprehensive selection of feed options tailored for various animals. Our expertise extends to custom grinding and mixing services, ensuring that each animal receives the nutrition it needs.
Our commitment to quality extends to your outdoors, with our extensive lawn services including lawn seeding, landscaping, and maintenance. Our fully stocked store caters to a wide array of needs, providing everything from animal feed to lawn supplies. At Knightstown Elevator, Inc. we are not just a business; we are a part of the community, devoted to supporting our customers with unparalleled service and dedication.
1-800-498-6949 or 765-345-2181
Our History
Tom Haase purchased KEI from Ed Springer (W.D. Springer & Sons) in 1973 after managing the business for the Springer's since 1959. Since that time the business has grown from hauling coal from its coal yard to Knightstown residents and business to what it is now.
Still owned and managed by the 2nd & 3rd generations Haase Family along with a dedicated & committed group of employees; it continues the tradition Tom Haase began all those years ago...delivering quality service & products to its customers.
